cohorts.name: Actual SDK/service Chrome workspace with synthetic planner and policies
Actual deployed public MCP and loopback cross-origin pairing

limitations: Separate Playwright Chrome profile, not the user Chrome profile.
Live handoff verifies delivery of the inspection instruction; it does not assert that relay automatically executes or returns a recipient inspection.
No private task content or unfinished action is replayed during recovery.
Full Phase 1/2 certification and previously deferred native device/accessibility cases remain separate.
